topSignals.title: PJM's 6 GW data-center capacity backstop auction is now live.
topSignals.text: Bidding opened today, Sept 30, and runs through Oct 21 — the first real-world test of the FERC-approved backstop mechanism, which trade press expects to favor fast-deploy, grid-independent generation (batteries seen as having the edge) over long-lead assets. The outcome will be an early data point on how PJM values behind-the-meter/on-site generation, including SOFC, relative to grid-connected alternatives. Energy-Storage.News

topSignals.title: Priority stack check — Elcogen and Topsoe both quiet for a third straight day.
topSignals.text: Direct checks of both companies' news/press-release pages show nothing published since Elcogen's already-logged Sept 21 (Metrosert testing tie-up) and Sept 23 (SOEC whitepaper) items; Topsoe's news page shows no items dated to the current window at all. Elcogen News, Topsoe News

topSignals.title: No other material developments; the regulatory calendar is thickening for October.
topSignals.text: Extended English/German searches across deployments, competing on-site power, market/financials, research, and LCOE-relevant data turned up nothing dated to the last 24-48h beyond items already on file. Four decision points now cluster in the next month: the PJM auction closes Oct 21; Germany's EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket committee hearings run Oct 5/7 with a final vote targeted around Oct 16; the KWK-Gesetz (CHP law) goes to cabinet Oct 14; and Bloom Energy reports Q3 earnings Oct 27.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet — no new stack/cell, capacity, or partnership news beyond the already-logged Sept 21 (Metrosert cooperation) and Sept 23 (SOEC whitepaper) items. Elcogen News
Topsoe (priority): Quiet — official news/press-release pages checked directly; no SOEC/SOFC, capacity, or partnership items dated to the last 24-48h. Topsoe News

Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin: no new stack/cell-technology announcements found in the window (financial/market news for Bloom, FuelCell Energy and Ceres covered below).
Live — see Top Signal #1:* PJM's 6 GW data-center capacity backstop auction opened its bidding window today, Sept 30, running through Oct 21.

No change* on the EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket Redispatz-Vorbehalt track: still as logged Sept 28/29 — committee hearings Oct 5 (EEG) / Oct 7 (Netzpaket), final vote targeted around Oct 16, both coalition negotiators still signaling the clause is likely to be dropped.
No change* on Germany's KWK-Gesetz (CHP law): cabinet consideration remains scheduled for Oct 14, as logged Sept 29.

No change* in the last 24-48h on: DOE/FERC large-load interconnection rulemaking (Apr 30, 2026 deadline); ITC 48E (30% fuel-cell credit) and 45V hydrogen credit; Virginia data-center electricity tax, New York permit moratorium, Texas development pause, EPA turbine NSPS; California's seven data-center bills signed Sept 21 (AB 1577, AB 2383, AB 2469, AB 2619, SB 886, SB 887, SB 1168) — all as previously logged.

Bloom Energy (BE): No new operational or financial disclosures in the window (Sept 28 news was a Philadelphia 76ers sponsorship/marketing deal, not fundamentals-relevant). Q3 earnings now four weeks out, due Oct 27.

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): No new operational disclosures in the window; Nov 10, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline (Fit Energy cost-overrun disclosure suit) still pending; backlog remains $3.6B per the Q3 transcript.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new market-moving news since the Sept 17 UK grid-connection-delay whitepaper.

lcoe.text: No new cost, efficiency, capex/opex, or gas/H2/electricity price datapoint published in the last 24-48h beyond already-logged items (Pan et al. $3.49/kg LCOH; Kourougianni et al. >30% annualized-cost reduction for rSOC+PV; Sept 25 EIA Henry Hub summer-2026 average of $2.93/MMBtu).

Pending calendar (updated): PJM 6 GW backstop auction bidding window Sept 30-Oct 21 (now open); German EEG/Netzpaket committee hearings Oct 5 (EEG) / Oct 7 (Netzpaket), final vote targeted Oct 16; German KWK-Gesetz cabinet consideration Oct 14; Bloom Q3 earnings Oct 27; FCEL lead-plaintiff deadline Nov 10; New Mexico air-quality permit deadline for Project Jupiter Nov 23.
